notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Hi! Here is another hotfix for RCD:

Fixes:
Fixed issue preventing players from hosting a game after being kicked from a lobby

Fixed Mutty collision problems 

Resolved pressure plates functionality on "Ward 13 Asylum" map

Addressed multiple collision issues on "Ward 13 Asylum"

Fixed collision problems in "Blackridge Basement" map

Eliminated ladder step duplication glitch

Corrected demon death behavior after final hunt sequence

Implemented minor adjustments to "Hollow Pines Residence" layout

Improved camera item functionality - now precisely captures paranormal objects

Hanging bodies and blood effects now properly register as paranormal objects

Revised electrical panel mechanics - now requires all switches to be activated

Resolved rare bug affecting first code puzzle in "Ward 13 Asylum"
Updates:
Removed medkit requirement for reviving teammates (medkits fully removed from game)

Introduced colored crosshair indicators for interactive object that are required to complete the mission

Added "Close" option to mission results screen

Implemented "Skip" button for mission results screen

Added looping siren sound effect to "Ward 13 Asylum"


Thank you for support!

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.content:
Hi! Here is another hotfix for RCD!  Fixes:
Fixed demon being able to hunt after death.

Fixed "Leave Game" button not working in singleplayer.

Fixed players disappearing after returning to lobby.

Fixed not being able to host a game after playing in singleplayer.

Fixed objective not progressing after selecting a different language.

Fixed saved settings not loading properly.
Updates:
Added "Brightness Scale" option in the video settings.

Added "Player List" with the ability to kick players during gameplay.

Voice chat has been brought back as an experimental feature; it is not expected to function properly.

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hi! YBT team here with a new hotfix!

This update addresses several critical issues and improves overall stability. Below are the full patch notes:


Fixes:
Gameplay

- Fixed demon collision issues  

- Fixed demon being unable to kill a player more than once  

- Fixed Camera Item not updating objective progress when photographing the demon  

- Fixed spectator camera glitches  

- Adjusted demon spawn location on the first map  

Multiplayer & Lobbies

- Fixed "friends-only" lobby type (replaced with functional "invite-only")  

- Fixed public 4-player lobbies not appearing in the server browser  

- Fixed joining session issues

- Fixed ping display in the server browser  

- Fixed return-to-lobby failure when all players die  

UI & Localization

- Fixed lost focus when opening the options menu with ESC  

- Fixed font size clipping and objective name stretching  

- Fixed reward counter inaccuracies  

- Updated lobby invite system (old button removed, now uses friendlist interface)  

- Added "Join Session" notification when accepting Steam invite or connecting to a public session

- Minor translation improvements  

Audio

- Fixed demon jumpscare sound


Updates & Changes:
- Voice chat is temporarily disabled for engine updates (will return in a future patch).  

- All maps are now unlocked from Level 1

- Russian language support has been removed.  


Known Issues:
- Voice chat will remain disabled until stability improvements are complete.  



Thank you to all our early supporters!

Special thank you to Kartaviy_Bober for streaming RCD and reporting bugs to us.

If you find any bugs in the game, address them in our Discord server.
